# Cursor BYOK v1.0.1

## 更新内容

- 修复文件编辑后重载 Cursor 窗口，Review 面板显示 “No changes to review” 的问题；连续编辑和恢复会话后仍保留文件差异。
- 升级 Tauri、ZIP、rustls、DOMPurify 等依赖，修复多项已知安全漏洞。
- 提供 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 的 macOS DMG 安装包，并整理各平台下载入口。

## Changes

- Fix file review diffs disappearing after reloading the Cursor window, including repeated edits and recovered conversations.
- Update Tauri, ZIP, rustls, DOMPurify, and other dependencies to address known security vulnerabilities.
- Include macOS DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel, with a clearer platform download guide.

## 注意事项 / Notes

- 旧会话中已丢失的 diff 无法自动恢复。Previously lost diffs cannot be restored automatically.
- Linux 仍受 Tauri 上游 GLib 依赖告警影响，详见 [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/leehainuo/cursor-byok/blob/v1.0.1/SECURITY.md)。The upstream GLib advisory remains open for Linux builds.
